C0198.title: CCTV Investigation: Rapid Follower Growth Tricks Using Mutual Follows and Likes to Fake Traffic
C0198.summary: A CCTV 'Common Concern' investigation reveals online tricks for rapidly gaining followers through mutual follows and likes, creating an illusion of traffic. This fake engagement does not reflect an account's true quality, violates principles of honesty and integrity, and constitutes typical batch following and engagement manipulation.
